scripts.build:local:ios: mkdir -p build/artifacts && eas build --local --platform ios --profile production --output build/artifacts/<app>-ios.ipa
scripts.build:local:android: mkdir -p build/artifacts && eas build --local --platform android --profile production --output build/artifacts/<app>-android.aab
scripts.build:local:apk: mkdir -p build/artifacts && eas build --local --platform android --profile production-apk --output build/artifacts/<app>-android.apk
